questions.prompt_html: \text{极限} \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{2 \arcsin x}{3 x} = [ \quad ].

options.label: B

questions.analysis_html: \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{2 \arcsin x}{3 x} = \frac{2}{3} \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\arcsin x^{\diamond x = \sin t}}{x} = \frac{2}{3} \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{t}{\sin t} = \frac{2}{3}

questions.prompt_html: \text{当} c \neq 0 \text{时，极限} \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{ \sin ax - \sin bx}{ \sin cx} = [\quad].

options.label: C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\sqrt{1+\tan x}-\sqrt{1+\sin x}}{x(1-\cos x)}=\lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\tan x-\sin x}{(\sqrt{1+\tan x}+\sqrt{1+\sin x})x(1-\cos x)}\\&=\frac{1}{2}\lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\tan x(1-\cos x)}{x(1-\cos x)}=\frac{1}{2}\lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{\cos x}\frac{\sin x}{x}=\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x \rightarrow \infty} x \sin \frac{1}{x} = 1; \text{“}\\&\lim_{x \rightarrow \infty} \frac{\sqrt{x^2-1}}{x} = -1, \lim_{x \rightarrow \infty} \frac{\sqrt{x^2-1}}{x} = 1, \text{所以不存在;} \\&\lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{1+e^{\frac{1}{x}}} = 0, \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{1+e^{\frac{1}{x}}} = 1, \text{所以不存在;} \\&\lim_{x \rightarrow \infty} \frac{1}{2^{x}-1} = 0, \lim_{x \rightarrow \infty} \frac{1}{2^{x}-1} = -1, \text{所以不存在.}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}x\sin \frac{1}{x}=\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}\frac{\sin \frac{1}{x}}{\frac{1}{x}}=1,\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}\frac{\sin x}{x}=\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}\frac{1}{x}\sin x=0,\forall x\\&\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}(1-\frac{1}{x})^{x}=\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}(1-\frac{1}{x})^{-x(-1)}=e^{-1},\\&\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}(1+\frac{1}{x})^{x}=e\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{极限} \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{ \sin x - \tan x }{ ( \sqrt[3]{1+x^{2}} ) ( \sqrt{1+\sin x}-1) } = [ \quad ] .

options.label: C
options.html: \text{不存在} \leftarrow

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\sin x - \tan x}{(\sqrt[3]{1+x^2}) (\sqrt{1+\sin x}-1)} &= \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\sin x - \tan x}{\frac{1}{3}x^2 \cdot \frac{1}{2}\sin x} = 6 \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\sin x \cdot \frac{1}{\cos x}(\cos x-1)}{x^2 \cdot \sin x} \\&= 6 \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\cos x-1}{x^2} = 6 \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{-2 \sin^2 \frac{x}{2}}{x^2} = -3 \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\sin^2 \frac{x}{2}}{(\frac{x}{2})^2} = -3\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设}f(x)=x\sin\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{x}\sin x, \lim_{x\to 0}f(x)=a, \lim_{x\to\infty}f(x)=b, \text{则有}\left[\quad\right].

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}a&=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}f(x)=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}x\sin\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{x}\sin x=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}x\sin\frac{1}{x}+\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{1}{x}\sin x=0+1=1,\\b&=\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}f(x)=\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}x\sin\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{x}\sin x=\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}x\sin\frac{1}{x}+\lim_{x\rightarrow \infty}\frac{1}{x}\sin x=1+0=1.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{\sqrt{1+x\sin x}-\cos x}{\sin^2\frac{x}{2}}=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{(\sqrt{1+x\sin x}-\cos x)(\sqrt{1+x\sin x}+\cos x)}{\sin^2\frac{x}{2}(\sqrt{1+x\sin x}+\cos x)}\\&=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{\sin x(\sin x+x)}{\sin^2\frac{x}{2}}\cdot\frac{1}{2}=\frac{1}{2}\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{x(\sin x+x)}{(\frac{x}{2})^2}=2\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{(\sin x}{x}+1)=4\end{aligned}
